source_sites.temporal_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years

scar_add.dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

why_v2.v1_problem: The v1 <=5% multiple-polygon rule confounded matching ambiguity with genuine archipelago density.
why_v2.pre_outcome_diagnostic: Known Torgersen Island intersects exactly one land polygon at 0 m but has 60 land polygons within 5 km; therefore the number of polygons inside a buffer is not a valid uniqueness metric.
why_v2.change: Gate 1A now audits only whether a site has at least one land polygon within the predeclared tolerance. Polygon assignment uniqueness is deferred to Gate 1B.

coverage_gate.selection_rule: Choose the smallest distance at which at least 95% of the 122 candidate APBP sites have one or more SCAR ADD land polygons at or within that distance.
coverage_gate.algorithm: Query distances in ascending order. Sites matched at a smaller distance are carried forward and are not re-queried. Stop at the first distance satisfying the 95% rule.
coverage_gate.arcgis_quota_handling: No parallel spatial requests. Retry JSON-level ArcGIS 429 responses after 65 seconds without changing query parameters.
coverage_gate.failure_rule: If 95% coverage is not reached by 5 km, Gate 1A v2 fails; do not expand the tolerance.

output_only: first land-match distance for each site
land object IDs returned at first match
outcome_blind_boundary: no population trend or endpoint is read
no manual site-name rescue is allowed before Gate 1A v2 is evaluated
next_gate: Gate 1B assigns one land polygon per covered site using a separately frozen nearest-polygon rule and derives island architecture.
